hero.title: GeoAnalyzer
hero.subtitle: Intelligent urban environment analysis system for data-driven decision making

mission.text_1: An intelligent response to the lack of transparency in the real estate market. We prove that quality of life and comfort are not subjective feelings, but concrete, measurable indicators. Our platform transforms millions of raw urban data points into precise analytical rankings.
mission.text_2: We are creating a new standard for urban analytics. Our goal is to provide every user — from tenants to strategic investors — with the tools for a deep understanding of infrastructure, safety, and the potential of any neighborhood.

features.title: Social Infrastructure
features.text: In-depth analysis of educational and medical networks. We evaluate not just the number of schools and hospitals, but their actual accessibility and density per capita.

features.title: Transport Logistics
features.text: Comprehensive mobility assessment: from proximity to metro and tram lines to the length of bike lanes and parking zone availability.

features.title: Safety & Order
features.text: Monitoring of crime rates, street lighting quality, and the density of video surveillance systems (CCTV) for your peace of mind.

features.title: Ecology & Urban Environment
features.text: Objective data on air quality, noise pollution levels, green space percentage, and the availability of recreational areas within walking distance.

features.title: Commercial Potential
features.text: Market saturation analysis: from grocery chains and shopping malls to bank branches and catering establishments.

features.title: Economic Indicators
features.text: Analytics on price per square meter, rental rate dynamics, and average local salary for accurate ROI calculation.

process.title: Geographic Focus
process.text: Use the interactive map to instantly select a city or outline a specific search area within Poland.

process.title: Intelligent Scoring
process.text: The algorithm automatically analyzes the location based on over 50 Big Data parameters and generates detailed environment quality rankings.

process.title: Comparative Analytics
process.text: Compare metrics of several neighborhoods side-by-side to uncover hidden advantages and critical drawbacks of each location.

process.title: Final Assessment & Report
process.text: Receive a comprehensive analysis of costs, infrastructure, and risks in a convenient format for informed decision-making.

data_sources.title: Methodology & Data Processing:
items: Multi-level verification and cleaning of raw data
Automated aggregation of indicators using proprietary algorithms
Daily updates of dynamic indicators (prices, ecology)
Geospatial linking of infrastructure objects to neighborhood boundaries
Intelligent anomaly detection and result validation by analysts

audience.title: Private Individuals
audience.text: For those seeking the perfect balance between price and quality of life. Find a quiet neighborhood with schools or a vibrant center for young professionals.

audience.title: Private Investors
audience.text: Minimize risks by relying on hard facts rather than intuition. Evaluate the capital growth potential of a district.

audience.title: Realtors & Agencies
audience.text: Boost your expertise in the eyes of clients. Utilize our professional White Label reports.

audience.title: Developers
audience.text: Analyze the competitive environment and infrastructure needs of a district before breaking ground.
